jutsu.name: Windlash Focus
jutsu.description: Shared pool record EA03. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a tight current of wind around their body until their sleeves snap and flutter. The gale rides every strike they throw, adding force to their next attacks.

jutsu.name: Omen: Fore Rows
jutsu.description: A warning mark. Whatever it marks is struck on the caster's next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user sweeps an arm across the field, and two rows of floor glow red.

jutsu.name: Unbroken Command
jutsu.description: An enduring command imprint sharpens offensive technique and lends greater force to attacks.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user calls on an order that was never rescinded, and the old command burns through their glass-bound body as their offensive power rises.

jutsu.name: Unraveling Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S31. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user slips a blow past %target's guard and drives chakra into it like a wedge. Every enhancement wrapped around them comes apart at once.

jutsu.name: Ship's Bell
jutsu.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Binding Ring): the bell tolls; push 3 and a 1-round lock inside the ring.

effects.description: Redirects the target towards or away from the user by power number of spaces
Seals the target's ability to use all elemental 60 AP jutsu
Increases AP cost of actions by 10

jutsu.battleDescription: %user strikes the deck with his blade. "All hands." The great bell answers.

jutsu.name: Steady the Helm
jutsu.description: The Captain falls back to his helm and takes command of the deck. He shakes off whatever holds him, and for 2 rounds he takes far less damage, turns part of it aside, and cannot be stripped of his guard.

effects.description: Clears all negative effects from the target

jutsu.battleDescription: %user falls back to the helm and sets both hands on the rail. "Steady. Steady."

jutsu.name: Omen: Chain Ring
jutsu.description: A warning mark. Whatever it marks is struck on the caster's next turn.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws a violet seal in the air, and a ring of script binds the floor around them.

jutsu.name: Broadside
jutsu.description: The Captain's signature (Omen: Rows, set A): the ship's guns fire down the marked rows.

jutsu.name: Suppression Writ
jutsu.description: A command seal weakens the target's attacks, leaves them more vulnerable, and impairs their healing ability.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user casts a suppression writ upon %target, its tightening script dulling their strikes, opening their guard, and disrupting their healing chakra.

jutsu.name: Raise the Gunwale
jutsu.description: The Captain hauls up a wall of ship's timber bound in seal script. It blocks the way and has its own health: break it down or go around.

effects.description: Creates a barrier with level corresponding to power

jutsu.battleDescription: %user stamps the deck, and a wall of timber and seal script rises along the gunwale.

jutsu.name: Battle Trance
jutsu.description: Heightened strength of body and mind.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user enters a battle trance, strength rising.

jutsu.name: Explosive Tag Cataclysm
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B14. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user flings a sheaf of explosive tags toward %target and ignites them with a single surge of chakra. The tags wrap around %target and detonate together in one deafening blast.

jutsu.name: Keelbind
jutsu.description: Chakra moorings strike and anchor the target while draining health, chakra, and stamina over time.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user lashes chakra moorings at %target, the lines closing around their footing as a draining pulse runs through each strand.

jutsu.name: Second Wind
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S35. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user draws on a last reserve of chakra deep in the belly and breathes it out through their body. Their wounds begin to close and their footing steadies.

jutsu.name: Counter Stance
jutsu.description: A posture that returns what it receives.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes a counter stance; what strikes them answers for it.

jutsu.name: Stolen Form
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B07. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user locks eyes with %target and reads the flow of their chakra like brushwork on a scroll. With a quick run of hand seals, %user copies the strengths %target carries and makes them their own.

jutsu.name: Final Command
jutsu.description: A crushing command strike disrupts the target's actions and attempts to suppress their bloodline effects.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user drives a command seal toward %target with a crushing blow, its flaring script threatening to scatter their rhythm and suppress their bloodline power.

item.name: Cursed Dagger
item.battleDescription: %user swipes at %target with the Cursed Dagger, leaving lasting wounds that can't be mended by normal means

item.name: AI Heavy Armor
item.description: Heavy dmg reduction item for AI
